notes.title: My Grandpa's Haunted House is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017057/790333ded9d21fb050514d8d603107c5284a16b8.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

The wait is over! I am proudly presenting my new 50th title called My Grandpa's Haunted House which is now available on Steam! If you are into 2D Survival horror games then, this might be the game for you.

[h1]Check it out now:[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2870070/My_Grandpas_Haunted_House/


Please give this game a try. Your feedback is valuable to me. So, please let me know if you encounter issues.

There is a huge discount on [b]Indie Horror Games Bundle #2[/b] for celebrating the release of my 50th project called My Grandpa's Haunted House game on Steam and if you would like to purchase multiple horror games at a huge discount then this is your chance.

[h1]Get Indie Horror Games Bundle #2 here:[/h1] https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/33469/Indie_Horror_Games_Bundle_2/

Thanks to everyone who have been supporting me on Steam! Creating and releasing this game on Steam would have never been possible without your support.

I hope you will enjoy the game. Happy Gaming!

Best Regards,
Anamik

notes.title: Fear Half Factor Update - Save And Load Feature!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It has come to my notice that some players wanted to have [b]"Checkpoint system"[/b] or [b]"Save and Load"[/b] feature in the game considering the length of the gameplay. I listened to your feedback and thus introduced "Save and Load" feature. 

I have introduced 12 Checkpoints in the game especially in the later levels where there is a spike in difficulty so that you don't have to start over from the beginning which I believe might be very frustrating.

At certain levels the game will be auto-saved during gameplay session. You can load them pretty easily by clicking on "LOAD" button from the the main menu screen.

I hope it will solve the issue and I hope you will enjoy the game. Since the game has been updated with new features some bugs might arise out of it and will be fixed with the next update. 

I have also fixed some lagging issues and should work on older PC as intended.

Thank you very much for your patience! If you encounter any bug please let me know in the discussions section I will definitely take a look. 

Best Regards,
Anamik

notes.title: Fear Half Factor is Released finally!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The wait is over! Fear Half Factor is now playable on Steam and I hope some of you will enjoy the game. This game is addictive and challenging. Difficulty will increase as you proceed. 

I hope that you will enjoy it and please let me know if you run into problems and report them in the discussion section. I will try to fix them as soon as possible. 

Thank you very much for your continuous support! 

This game currently has the following features:

1. Full XBOX 360 Controller Support!
2. 48 Steam Achievements!

Best Regards,
Anamik
